title: Rosehip face oil
subtitle: A dry, fast-absorbing blend for skin tone, texture, and dryness
excerpt: A simple three-oil face blend centred on rosehip seed oil, with a little sea buckthorn for colour and vitamin content, and jojoba as a stabiliser. Rosehip seed oil is rich in linoleic acid and beta-carotene. Applied morning or evening. Gives about 30 ml of oil. Shelf life 6 months.
sourceNotes: Rosehip seed oil (Rosa canina): high linoleic acid (~40%) and beta-carotene; traditional use for uneven skin tone and dryness. Oxidises relatively quickly, shelf life 6 months. Sea buckthorn berry oil (Hippophae rhamnoides): extremely high beta-carotene and vitamin E; use at 2-3% maximum as it gives a strong orange tint to the skin at higher concentrations. Jojoba (Simmondsia chinensis): technically a liquid wax, very oxidatively stable, extends shelf life when blended with rosehip. Vitamin E (tocopherol) as antioxidant extends shelf life by approx 30% when added at 0.5-1%.

recipe.batchNotes: Scale up to 100 ml batches maximum. Rosehip oil has a short shelf life; larger batches oxidise before you use them.
recipe.makeAheadNotes: Ready immediately. Store in a dark amber bottle from day one.
recipe.shelfLifeNotes: 6 months from blending. Rosehip oil oxidises faster than most carrier oils. Keep refrigerated to extend to 9 months. Discard if the oil smells sharp, musty, or crayon-like.

glossaryTerms.definition: An omega-6 fatty acid found in high concentrations in rosehip and hemp seed oil. Associated with supporting the skin barrier and improving transepidermal water loss in dry and sensitive skin types.
A fat-soluble antioxidant added to face oils at 0.5-1% to slow oxidation of unstable oils like rosehip, extending shelf life.

content.text: Weigh all the oils into the amber bottle. Add the vitamin E drops.
Cap the bottle and roll gently between your palms to combine. No heat is needed.
Label with the blend date. Keep in the fridge or a dark cupboard.
Apply 3-4 drops to clean, slightly damp skin. Press in rather than rubbing. Suitable for morning or evening use. The sea buckthorn gives the oil a slight golden colour that washes off.
6 months at room temperature; 9 months refrigerated. Rosehip oil deteriorates faster than most carrier oils. Discard if the oil smells sharp or crayon-like, both are signs of rancidity.
